reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that automates a local MATLAB-to-ModelSim-to-Vivado workflow for digital communication IC design, including modeling, RTL compilation and simulation, synthesis, implementation, and bitstream generation.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 MATLAB、ModelSim 和 Vivado 工具，帮助智能体执行数字通信 IC 的建模、RTL 仿真、综合、实现与比特流生成流程。
summaries.en: Helps agents run a local MATLAB, ModelSim, and Vivado workflow for digital communication IC modeling, RTL simulation, synthesis, implementation, and bitstream generation.

capabilities: Detects MATLAB, ModelSim, and Vivado availability and versions
Initializes digital communication IC design workspaces
Executes local MATLAB scripts or expressions
Compiles and simulates Verilog, SystemVerilog, and VHDL with ModelSim
Runs Vivado Tcl scripts and standard synthesis, implementation, and bitstream flows
Directly spawns local EDA processes and reads their output
